name: Water-Based vs Oil-Based Floor Finish: What Bellevue Homes Choose
title-tag: Water-Based vs Oil-Based Floor Finish: A Bellevue, WA Guide
meta-description: Water-based or oil-based finish for your Bellevue home? A local refinishing contractor compares dry times, fumes, ambering, and durability, line by line.
post-summary: August 28, 2026 · Water-based finishes dry in hours, stay clear for life, and — in commercial two-component grades — now out-wear oil-based poly. Oil still earns its place on red oak in empty houses. A comparison written for Bellevue and Eastside homes: schedule, smell, color in year ten, and what we'd put in our own house.
